name: Motorcycle
description: A motor vehicle on two or three wheels other than a moped, including what the trade calls motorcycles and scooters; an electric two-wheeler that can exceed 70 km/h, such as an e-moto, is one.

restrictions.rule: Two or three wheels; includes what the trade calls motorcycles and scooters; not a moped
restrictions.citation: Traffic Safety Act, R.S.N.W.T. 1988, c. M-16, s. 1

restrictions.rule: No limit on motor power or speed
restrictions.citation: Traffic Safety Act, R.S.N.W.T. 1988, c. M-16, s. 1

restrictions.rule: Riders need a Class 6 licence, from age 16
restrictions.citation: Driver's Licence Regulations, R.R.N.W.T. 1990, c. M-27, s. 3(2) and Schedule A

restrictions.rule: A Class 7 learner, from 15, rides accompanied, or followed and kept in view by an instructor with two years' motorcycle experience, never after sunset or in a speed zone of 70 km/h or more
restrictions.citation: Driver's Licence Regulations, R.R.N.W.T. 1990, c. M-27, ss. 3(3) and 4

restrictions.rule: Every rider and passenger must wear a prescribed helmet
restrictions.citation: Traffic Safety Act, R.S.N.W.T. 1988, c. M-16, s. 243

restrictions.rule: A passenger rides only on a seat built for one or in a sidecar; nobody stands while riding
restrictions.citation: Traffic Safety Act, R.S.N.W.T. 1988, c. M-16, s. 242

restrictions.rule: Registered and plated to be ridden on a highway, and covered by a motor vehicle liability policy to be ridden or parked on one
restrictions.citation: Traffic Safety Act, R.S.N.W.T. 1988, c. M-16, ss. 5, 6 and 36(2)

restrictions.rule: One built for cross-country travel off the highway is an all-terrain vehicle instead
restrictions.citation: Traffic Safety Act, R.S.N.W.T. 1988, c. M-16, s. 1; All-terrain Vehicles Act, R.S.N.W.T. 1988, c. A-3, s. 1(1)
